Livestock Officer

Anonymous Employer

Farming & Agriculture

2 days ago
Easy apply New Featured
Imo Full Time Agriculture, Fishing & Forestry Confidential

Share link

Share on WhatsApp Share on LinkedIn Share on Facebook Share on Twitter

Job summary

We are seeking a responsible and experienced Livestock Officer to oversee the daily care, feeding, health, and management of livestock on the farm.

Min Qualification: Degree Experience Level: Entry level Experience Length: 1 year Language Requirement: English Working Hours: Full Time - 8 to 5 Applicant Location: Imo, Nigeria

Job descriptions & requirements

Responsibilities:

  • Manage feeding, breeding, and general livestock care.
  • Monitor animal health and identify signs of illness.
  • Maintain clean and hygienic animal housing.
  • Keep accurate livestock and medication records.
  • Ensure proper animal handling and welfare.
  • Support daily farm operations.


Requirements:

  • Degree in animal science, animal husbandry, agriculture, or related field.
  • 1–2 years’ relevant experience.
  • Good knowledge of livestock management.
  • Good observation and communication skills.
  • A workstation Accommodation is provided in the farm


Location: Farm-based in Imo State
